points: This carryover audit supplements only G2 and G3; G0/G4/G5/G1 are inherited from the captured record.

A real Chrome session read the complete first two US-English pages without CAPTCHA. Page one has one exact Dataform guide followed by generic Google MCP tutorials, remote-server deployment, BigQuery MCP, Dataform pipelines and Cloud Run MCP material; page two drops into Dataform deployment, other product MCP servers, Terraform and unrelated integrations.

G2=pass: the result set is fragmented across inner docs, small tutorials and adjacent products, and the second page is a clear Dataform-exactness quality cliff without task-completing media or homepage takeover.

Google's exact guide is a complete implementation, updated 2026-08-17 UTC: it covers API enablement, Dataform/BigQuery setup, MCP Tool User plus Dataform/BigQuery roles, OAuth scopes, the regional HTTPS endpoint, client configuration, tools, prompts, Model Armor and IAM deny controls.

G3=pass: no second free page completes Dataform remote MCP setup. Generic Google MCP tutorials target Maps or other services, while Cloud Run articles build custom servers and BigQuery results use a different managed endpoint.
This is not veto_window_bet because no second already-built exact Dataform implementation is merely awaiting indexing.
Window estimate is weeks, expiring 2026-09-20. The only exact guide is three days old, while the broader Google managed-MCP ecosystem can create exact tutorials rapidly.

Invalidation conditions: two free end-to-end Dataform remote MCP guides enter the SERP; Google publishes a dedicated Dataform codelab; regional endpoint, OAuth scope, MCP Tool User role, supported clients, or available tools change.
